purpose: Learn a numerical proposal for fresh anchored sampling from an already evaluated complete SN-replacement bridge. Training does not qualify that bridge or turn its diagnostics into a measurement.
prerequisites: The original parent must freshly qualify; every anchored factor evaluation and source-density closure must pass. A child failing only overlap/stability may inform a proposal. Replaying the complete cached bridge must match its saved report exactly with background/model/spectrum evaluation forbidden.
partition: Sort each of four chains by its original expanded_index. Use the first80percent of each selected-point sequence for training; withhold the last20percent. At least2000 total points and100 withheld points per chain. The split is fixed before the bridge is examined.
weights: Use raw anchored target/proposal logweights on training points only, normalized by logsumexp. No clipping, smoothing, winsorization or replacement of tail points.
coordinates: Whiten with the independently frozen original Dovekie proposal Cholesky and mean. Compute weighted population mean and covariance. Set covariance_white=0.95*empirical_covariance_white+0.05*I, then transform back. This fixed regularization is a proposal choice, not an observational covariance change.
proposal: Reuse unchanged FrozenMixture:0.9 Normal(mean,1.05^2*C)+0.1 StudentT5(mean,scale=4*(5-2)/5*C). It has full real support; scientific prior/domain rejections belong to the target.
training_quality: Require raw training ESS>=max(20,2*number_of_parameters), finite coordinates/weights and a positive definite regularized covariance. Failure rejects this proposal construction only; it says nothing about the physical model.
validation: Independent weighted-moment algebra, held-out perturbation invariance, common-weight-offset invariance, duplicate/omitted partition rejection, concentrated-weight rejection, normalized mixture agreement with SciPy, and immutable snapshot/source tamper rejection. No observational training or native model calls in validation.
interpretation: Weighted bridge summaries remain diagnostics when their scientific gates fail. The trained proposal can miss unseen modes; fresh independently seeded chains, unchanged convergence gates and native correction are still required. A separate bounded pilot tests efficiency before production.
